blocks.section: How can I ski for free?
blocks.heading: How can I ski for free?

spans.text: Husky Winter Sports brings together a group of current UW students each season to teach, learn, and shred together. After joining through our tryout process, instructors spend each weekend of winter quarter up at Snoqualmie Pass. Each weekend, instructors will teach two 2.5 hour lessons, go through official PSIA/AASI training, and of course, get to ski with all their friends.

In exchange for teaching lessons, instructors receive a free season pass, weekend accommodations at the mountain, transportation to and from Snoqualmie, a special Saturday night dinner, fun trips around the PNW, a sick community of outdoor enthusiasts, and so much more! That’s right, it’s all for free!
